description: Finds the DfT local authority id, ONS code and region for a council from its name (partial names work, e.g. "Leeds", "Bristol", "Kingston"), or from an ONS code such as E08000035. Use it before local_authority_traffic_totals or traffic_count_points_in_council. Covers Great Britain councils as DfT lists them, including some former councils kept for older years; it is not a postcode lookup. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, council name or part of it, or an ONS code like E08000035

name: traffic_local_authority_find
